basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Forest Management (IIFM), Bhopal has invited online applications for 01 unreserved post of Stenographer Grade II on a direct recruitment basis under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India. Interested and eligible candidates may submit their online applications through the designated portal.

selection_process: The applications will be screened and shortlisted based on essential educational qualifications and experience. Only shortlisted applicants will be called for a written test and skill test for the further selection process.
how_to_apply: Visit the official IIFM recruitment portal or use the online application link.
Fill out the online application form with the required details before the last date.
Upload the desired self-attested documents as required in the application portal.
Persons employed in Central/State Government, PSUs, and Autonomous Bodies must also route a hard copy of their application through proper channel to the Chief Administrative Officer.
For any queries regarding the online submission process, send an email to [email protected].
important_instructions: Fulfilling the minimum educational qualifications or other requirements does not bestow any right on the applicants to be called for the selection process. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. The Institute reserves the right to fill or not to fill the post. No interim correspondence will be entertained regarding the recruitment process. All updates and further information related to this notification will be available only on the official IIFM website.

content_sections.heading: About IIFM Stenographer Grade II
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Forest Management is an autonomous academic institution situated in Bhopal under the Ministry of Environment, Forests & Climate Change, Govt. of India. The institute conducts direct recruitment for administrative positions to support its academic and operational activities.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notice announces a total of 01 vacancy for the Stenographer Grade II position. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational qualifications, skill test norms, and experience criteria specified for the post. Educational Qualification: 12th class pass from a recognized Board or University. Skill Test Norms: Dictation: 10 Minutes @ 80 words per minute in English. Transcription: 50 minutes in English (only on computers). Experience: Two-year relevant experience in a government or reputed private organization.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate for Stenographer Grade II will receive a salary in Pay Level - 4 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIFM Stenographer Grade II
content_sections.text: Visit the official IIFM recruitment portal or use the online application link. Fill out the online application form with the required details before the last date. Upload the desired self-attested documents as required in the application portal. Persons employed in Central/State Government, PSUs, and Autonomous Bodies must also route a hard copy of their application through proper channel to the Chief Administrative Officer. For any queries regarding the online submission process, send an email to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The applications will be screened and shortlisted based on essential educational qualifications and experience. Only shortlisted applicants will be called for a written test and skill test for the further selection process.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Fulfilling the minimum educational qualifications or other requirements does not bestow any right on the applicants to be called for the selection process. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. The Institute reserves the right to fill or not to fill the post. No interim correspondence will be entertained regarding the recruitment process. All updates and further information related to this notification will be available only on the official IIFM website.
